summary: Defines a fully specified forward error correction scheme using Reed-Solomon codes, applied to reliable delivery of data over channels where packets either arrive intact or are lost. Extra repair packets let receivers rebuild lost data.

eli5.summary: If a puzzle has a few pieces missing, spare pieces cut with a clever rule can fill the gaps. This note describes such spare pieces so a file can be rebuilt even when some packets get lost.

questions: how does forward error correction recover lost packets
